label: Animals, Pets & Wildlife
labelVi: Động vật, Thú cưng & Thế giới hoang dã
descriptionVi: Từ vựng về các loài thú cưng trong nhà, gia súc, động vật hoang dã và hành vi động vật.

words.vi: con mèo đực (tomcat), gà tây trống
words.senseNote: Thuật ngữ chỉ con mèo đực trưởng thành hoặc gà tây trống nuôi trong trang trại

examples.en: Our ginger tom sleeps peacefully curled up on the sunny window ledge.
examples.vi: Chú mèo đực lông vàng cam của chúng tôi ngủ bình yên cuộn tròn trên bậu cửa sổ đầy nắng.

examples.en: A large tom strutted proudly across the green farmyard, puffing its feathers.
examples.vi: Một chú gà tây trống to lớn oai vệ sải bước ngang qua sân nông trại xanh tươi, xòe phồng lông của mình.

words.vi: con mèo
words.senseNote: Động vật bốn chân ăn thịt nhỏ có lông mềm, được nuôi làm thú cưng trong nhà

examples.en: The playful white cat jumped onto the kitchen counter to chase a toy mouse.
examples.vi: Chú mèo trắng tinh nghịch đã nhảy lên quầy bếp để đuổi theo một con chuột đồ chơi.

examples.en: She gently stroked her pet cat while watching an evening television show.
examples.vi: Cô ấy nhẹ nhàng vuốt ve chú mèo cưng của mình trong lúc xem chương trình truyền hình buổi tối.
examples.ipaUs: /ʃiː ˈdʒent.li stroʊkt hɚ pet kæt waɪl ˈwɑː.tʃɪŋ æn ˈiːv.nɪŋ ˈtel.ə.vɪʒ.ən ʃoʊ/

words.vi: con chó
words.senseNote: Loài thú bốn chân trung thành được nuôi làm bạn và trông nhà cho con người

examples.en: Our golden retriever dog barks happily whenever someone arrives at the front door.
examples.vi: Chú chó giống golden retriever của chúng tôi sủa mừng vui vẻ bất cứ khi nào có ai đến cửa trước.

examples.en: He takes his faithful dog for a long walk in the park every morning.

words.vi: con cá, đàn cá cảnh
words.senseNote: Sinh vật sống dưới nước bơi bằng vây và thở bằng mang, thường được nuôi làm cảnh trong bể kính

examples.en: Bright orange goldfish swam gracefully around the water plants in the aquarium tank.
examples.vi: Những chú cá vàng màu cam rực rỡ bơi lội duyên dáng quanh các cụm thủy sinh trong bể kính.

words.vi: động vật, thú vật
words.senseNote: Sinh vật sống có tri giác và khả năng vận động tự nhiên trong thế giới hoang dã hay nuôi trong nhà

examples.en: Every wild animal in the national park is strictly protected by conservation rangers.
examples.vi: Mọi loài động vật hoang dã trong vườn quốc gia đều được các kiểm lâm viên bảo tồn nghiêm ngặt.

words.vi: con gấu rừng
words.senseNote: Loài thú ăn thịt và ăn thực vật lớn có lông dày sống trong các cánh rừng núi

examples.en: We put small sunflower seeds in the garden bird feeder every morning.

words.vi: bay lượn, cất cánh trên không

words.vi: con ngựa

words.vi: con khỉ

passages.title: A Wonderful Weekend at Green Valley Wildlife Park
passages.text: Spending time observing animal behavior in nature brings tremendous joy and understanding. Last Saturday, our family visited Green Valley Wildlife Park, a beautiful sanctuary dedicated to caring for every domestic animal and wild creature. Near the entrance, a friendly ginger tom cat rested peacefully on the wooden reception porch, purring softly as young visitors stroked its fur. Our playful pet dog walked gently on his leash beside us, wagging his tail happily. We first toured the traditional working farmstead, where healthy cows grazed on lush green pasture and clucking chicken flocks searched for grain in the farmyard. In a nearby paddock, a handsome brown horse galloped freely, tossing its mane in the morning breeze. Walking along the wooden boardwalk beside the freshwater stream, we observed colorful fish swimming through clear water while wild flying birds soared overhead. Soon, we watched a magnificent hawk fly high into the sky, demonstrating its effortless aerial grace. Later, our guided tram tour brought us to the large natural enclosures for protected wildlife. We watched a majestic brown bear splashing in a waterfall pool to cool down. Across the open grassy plain, a noble lion rested proudly on a rocky outcrop, observing its surroundings with regal calm. Seeing how each creature plays an essential role in the ecosystem reminded us of our shared responsibility to protect our living world. We returned home inspired by the astonishing diversity and beauty of the animal kingdom. Treating animals with kindness and safeguarding their natural habitats ensures that future generations will continue to enjoy the wonders of Earth's wildlife.

passages.title: A Joyful Day at Sunnyside Farm and Nature Sanctuary
passages.text: Visiting Sunnyside Farm and Nature Sanctuary provides a wonderful opportunity to learn about friendly domestic animals and wild creatures. Early in the morning, our guide greeted our group warmly beside the main entrance. We began our tour at the open farmyard, where a gentle dairy cow was chewing fresh hay calmly while waiting to be milked. Nearby, a fluffy white sheep walked closely beside its curious lamb across the lush meadow. In a clean wooden pen, a cheerful pink pig rolled contentedly in clean straw before enjoying its morning meal of corn and oats. As we walked toward the educational center, a small child gently stroked her pet rabbit, feeling its soft fur and watching its long ears twitch. Along the garden path, a busy honey bee buzzed softly around blooming purple flowers, gathering sweet nectar to produce delicious honey. Near the pond, we paused to watch a bright green frog leap gracefully from a large floating water lily into the clear water. The ranger showed us an educational terrarium where a harmless striped snake rested peacefully on a warm dry branch. Suddenly, we heard funny chattering sounds from the outdoor animal shelter, where an inquisitive rat scurried under a grain barrel, seeking crumbs. In the spacious woodland habitat higher up the sanctuary, an energetic brown monkey swung swiftly between sturdy oak branches, delighting all the visiting children. Our tour concluded at the wildlife conservation pavilion, where we learned how researchers protect the endangered Bengal tiger in Asian rainforests. Seeing how each creature enriches our ecosystem taught us to cherish and protect animal life everywhere.

passages.titleVi: Bảo vệ sự đa dạng động vật hoang dã trên cạn, trên trời và dưới biển
passages.text: Every living being on our planet deserves respect, protection, and a safe habitat to thrive. At the coastal nature sanctuary, conservation rangers work tirelessly to preserve biodiversity across diverse landscapes. Early in the morning, visitors walk along the forested valley path where a colorful blue jay flutters through the green pine canopy. Overhead, the agile bird stretches its bright blue wings, calling loudly while hunting small insects and pesky flies near the stream. Down in the meadow garden, a delicate monarch butterfly lands gracefully upon blooming lavender flowers to drink nectar. Nearby in the wildlife wetland pavilion, children watch a mother duck guiding her tiny yellow chick toward the water for morning feeding. In the historical education gallery, an exhibit describes how ancient folk cultures imagined the mystical dragon, revering it as a legendary protector of water and nature. Outside on the open grassland plains, a majestic herd of American buffalo grazes calmly under the warm sun. In an adjacent conservation enclosure, rangers care for a rare spotted leopard that was rescued from poachers. Sadly, many extraordinary animals have become threatened due to human encroachment and illegal hunting. In the specialized Asian sanctuary sector, biologists monitor Siberian tigers to ensure their population recovers safely. Later in the afternoon, the marine center introduces visitors to a rescued reef shark swimming smoothly in an expansive saltwater lagoon. Seeing these remarkable creatures highlights our shared moral duty to protect vulnerable habitats. When citizens support conservation and combat environmental destruction, wildlife flourishes for generations to come.

passages.title: Preserving Diverse Wildlife Across Forest and Meadow Habitats
passages.titleVi: Bảo tồn đời sống hoang dã đa dạng qua các sinh cảnh rừng và đồng cỏ
passages.text: Protecting our living world requires safeguarding both domestic farm animals and every wild creature that inhabits remote natural landscapes. Yesterday morning, our biology study group visited the highland wildlife eco-sanctuary to observe regional biodiversity up close. As we walked quietly along the misty pine ridge, a majestic red hart suddenly appeared between the tall birch trees, its magnificent branching antlers silhouetted against the bright dawn sky. Looking up into the high forest canopy, we spotted a cheerful singing robin that had carefully built a cozy nest using soft moss and dried twigs. Further down near the freshwater wetland, a gentle mother duck led her fluffy brood toward the shallow reed beds while searching for nutritious aquatic plants. Nearby along the perimeter path, an environmental ranger demonstrated how dedicated conservation teams locate and remove illegal wire traps that threaten native wildlife. Inside the rehabilitation clinic, veterinary staff were caring for an orphaned guinea pig and examining a rescued woodland turtle whose hard protective shell had been cracked by road traffic. The sanctuary educator explained that every living being, from a tiny garden songbird to a massive African elephant, plays a vital and irreplaceable ecological role. Without healthy forests, clean wetlands, and undisturbed grasslands, vulnerable wildlife populations cannot find adequate food or rear their young safely. When local communities actively promote habitat conservation, both humans and animals flourish in peaceful coexistence. We returned home deeply inspired by nature's resilience and committed to protecting our planet's shared wildlife heritage. Learning about these diverse creatures strengthens our dedication to ensuring that future generations inherit a thriving natural world filled with healthy ecosystems.

passages.title: A Day of Discovery and Care at the Woodland Wildlife Sanctuary
passages.titleVi: Một ngày khám phá và chăm sóc tại khu bảo tồn động vật hoang dã vùng rừng
passages.text: Last weekend, our eco-club visited a peaceful regional wildlife sanctuary nestled in a quiet river valley. Our morning began at the homestead farm, where a herd of black and white dairy cows grazed serenely on dew-covered pastures. Near the caretaker's cottage, a playful ginger kitty curled comfortably inside a wicker basket, purring happily in the morning sun. Inside the small animal nursery, children were delighted to watch a fluffy pet bunny nibbling on fresh dandelion greens. As we walked toward the wetland boardwalk, an emerald-headed mallard drake paddled across the tranquil marsh, keeping vigilant watch over the water. A sharp-eyed red-tailed hawk soared high overhead, scanning the tall meadow grasses for small prey. Along the footpath, our nature guide knelt down to examine a tiny, colorful insect crawling on a fern leaf, explaining how even microscopic creatures maintain ecological balance. Nearby, a curious student found a glistening blue jay feather lying softly beside the creek bed. In the educational center, visitors marveled at a cast fossil of a prehistoric dinosaur, learning how ancient species vanished from our planet. The educator emphasized that many modern animals have become endangered due to illegal hunting and deforestation. To protect vulnerable wildlife, rangers use humane cage traps scented with sweet fruit bait to catch and relocate trapped animals safely. Over the past year, dedicated sanctuary volunteers have nurtured dozens of rescued birds and injured mammals back to full strength. Caring for creatures both large and small reminds us that biodiversity enriches all human life. When communities protect fragile natural habitats, every animal finds an enduring home to thrive. Preserving this harmonious connection inspires timeless reverence for Earth's wildlife.
